waypoints.name: White River Campground
waypoints.note: Approach via Glacier Basin and St. Elmo Pass.
waypoints.directions: From Enumclaw, drive WA-410 east about 43 miles to the White River entrance of Mount Rainier National Park and turn right onto the Sunrise Road. After about 5 miles, cross the White River and turn left onto the White River Road, following it to its end at White River Campground; the Glacier Basin trailhead is at the upper end of the campground loop. A park entrance pass is required, and the road opens only in summer.
